info.name: FleetFuel Portal — API scenarios
info.description: Scenario collection for the FleetFuel Portal API (fictional data). Folders 01, 02 and 05 run against the implemented API (M06); folder 03 needs M07 (deliveries) and folder 04 needs M08 (reports and CSV). Password and tokens belong only in your selected, untracked environment. The first purchase saves its generated payload; replay and conflict reuse it. See postman/README.md.

exec: pm.test("Only active stations", () => pm.expect(body.data.every((s) => s.is_active === true)).to.be.true);
pm.test("DIESEL has an LBP price as a 4-decimal string", () => pm.expect(diesel.unit_price_lbp).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{4}$/));

pm.test("Indicative USD price and rate provenance", () => { pm.expect(diesel.indicative_unit_price_usd).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{4}$/); pm.expect(["fixture", "provider", "manual"]).to.include(diesel.rate_source); });
const cents = (s) => { const [whole, fraction = ""] = String(s).split("."); return parseInt(whole, 10) * 100 + parseInt((fraction + "00").slice(0, 2), 10); };
pm.test("At least 20.00 L left (otherwise prepare fresh cards, see README)", () => pm.expect(balance.remaining_l === null || cents(balance.remaining_l) >= 2000).to.be.true);
// A new reference and the current time, saved once; replay and conflict reuse this exact payload.
pm.test("Location header names the purchase", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/api/v1/transactions/" + purchase.id));
// The saved payload with only the liters changed.
const cents = (s) => { const [whole, fraction = ""] = String(s).split("."); return parseInt(whole, 10) * 100 + parseInt((fraction + "00").slice(0, 2), 10); };
pm.test("Exactly one 20.00 L debit (replay and declines charged nothing)", () => pm.expect(cents(balance.used_l) - cents(pm.environment.get("initial_used_l"))).to.eql(2000));

pm.test("Remaining liters went down by 20.00", () => { const before = pm.environment.get("initial_remaining_l"); if (before !== "") { pm.expect(cents(before) - cents(balance.remaining_l)).to.eql(2000); } });
pm.test("One history row, null -> pending", () => { pm.expect(history).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(history[0].from_status).to.eql(null); pm.expect(history[0].to_status).to.eql("pending"); });
pm.test("Delivery time set by the server", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.delivered_at).to.match(/Z$/));
